line: Established that the program was equivalent to usual care because the superiority test on readmission was not significant (p = 0.41).
defect: A non-significant superiority test does not show equivalence; equivalence needs a prespecified margin and an equivalence or non-inferiority test.

line: Estimated median survival in each arm by averaging the follow-up time of patients who died, excluding censored patients.
defect: Averaging follow-up of deaths while excluding censored patients is biased; median survival needs a Kaplan-Meier estimate that uses censored data.
